The natural habit of the conditioned ego is to panic, resist, or frantically search for a technique to control present reality. When we look into the living reality of this teaching, the master points out with unwavering clarity: *"The mind tells itself—even more clearly than if someone else were to tell it."* From the foundational perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering (*dukkha*) is never caused by the mere presence of sensations, thoughts, or external conditions.
